scanner: pnpm audit --json (pnpm 12.10.1) on the workspace pnpm-lock.yaml
scope_note: Only advisories whose dependency path starts at the importer apps/super-ontology-desktop are kept here; the full run also reports apps/web (storybook, zod) and packages/design-system rows that are outside this app.
prod_run_note: pnpm audit --prod reports one advisory (zod 4.6.5, high) and its only path is apps/web > zod; no advisory with a path from apps/super-ontology-desktop exists in the production dependency set.

Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections

dispositions.zod (high, GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5): Reached only as eslint-plugin-react-hooks > zod and zod-validation-error > zod (lint time). zod validates the plugin's own rule options read from the repository's eslint.config.mjs; no attacker input and no oversized collection reaches it. Not shipped (absent from app.asar). Patched in zod >= 4.6.6; the owner may bump eslint-plugin-react-hooks or override zod.
dispositions.undici 8.x (several high, moderate): Reached only as jsdom > undici (jsdom is a devDependency, also pulled in as an optional peer of vitest). vitest runs with environment node (config/vitest.config.ts) and no test or script imports jsdom, so undici is never loaded; it makes no network request. Not shipped (absent from app.asar). Patched in undici >= 8.12.2.
dispositions.minimatch (moderate, GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249: Reached through eslint, typescript-eslint, electron-builder and app-builder-lib; patterns are the repository's own globs, no untrusted pattern input. Build and lint time only; not shipped.
